studies.title: The domesticated camel
studies.caption: Camels, herded in Arabia for milk and meat, are now ridden and loaded for long desert crossings.
studies.prompt: Side-on view of a single-humped dromedary being loaded with balanced woven panniers in southeastern Arabia about1000BCE; hands tightening fiber lashings, sparse rocky desert and two distant animals. Early modest packs, no ornate tourist saddle or pyramids.
